sample_mapping_evidence: Primary36185375 and original GEO specify3PBMC/2marrow from5healthy adult donors. PBMC1..3GEX identify3blood specimens/3donors. Raw/filtered H5 are alternate releases of same specimen; use original filtered-barcode integerRNA counts. ADT/VDJ/marrow excluded.

source_processing: Gene expression libraries were sequenced together on a NovaSeq 6000 platform (Illumina, San Diego, CA). ADT and V(D)J libraries were sequenced separately on a Next-seq platform (Illumina, San Diego, CA).

Cell Ranger Software (v.3.1.0) was used to perform barcode processing and single-cell 5′ unique molecular identifier (UMI) counting. Reads from GEX and ADT libraries were processed simultaneously using “cellranger count” with "--r2-length=98 --expect-cells=5000", while reads from V(D)J libraries were aligned by running “cellranger vdj”.
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: mtx files are the sparse matrices of the gene expression and surface-protein expression data.

title: PBMC1 [GEX]
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from whole blood using EasySep™ Direct Human PBMC Isolation Kit (Catalog #19654 Stem Cell Technologies). B cells were enriched from fresh whole bone marrow using EasySep™ B Cell Enrichment: Complete Processing Kit for Whole Blood (Catalog # 19954 Stem Cell Technologies)
Libraries were prepared according to Chromium Single Cell V(D)J Reagent Kit (v1 Chemistry) with Feature Barcoding technology for Cell Surface Protein User Guide.

metadata.source_age_scope: Primary specifies adult donors; individual ages/sex not joined
metadata.source_alias_review: Three PBMC donors in five-donor blood/marrow study. Paired ADT/VDJ and marrow records are not additional blood specimens.
metadata.source_modality_review: Original filtered-barcode H5 selected; RNA count columns only, excluding any ADT feature rows before normalization. Filtered means barcode-called, not normalized expression.
